mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.7% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.7%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in the real economy, triggering reduced consumer and business spending that results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline by at least 0.5% over the prior 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 5.0% combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200.0) signals aggressive central bank policy that suppresses corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When residential housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units in a 1-month window, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST is below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market, when the unemployment rate is below 4.5% and employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 100,000 persons per month, it signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5% and PAYEMS exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates tightening monetary policy and reduced consumer spending, which together produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% and RSAFS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: monetary tightening with consumer credit contraction
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen by at least 0.25 percentage points and RSAFS has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 1 month.
